What works well (observed scope): Clear hero actions; visible course prices; FAQ and free entry; desktop/mobile layout fits.
Problem / uncertainty: Past cohort urgency, conflicting counts and stage thresholds.
Affected task and consequence: Applicants may believe registration is closed or expect rewards at the wrong thresholds.
Recommended change: Read campaign, catalogue and gem metadata from shared services.
Testable acceptance criteria: Displayed dates/counts/stage boundaries equal current product data and expired campaigns disappear.

What works well (observed scope): 39 emitted course-detail links resolve; cards communicate category, duration and price.
Problem / uncertainty: Page resolution does not establish lesson completeness; long list and stale 31-course link.
Affected task and consequence: Discovery takes excess effort and content freshness is unclear.
Recommended change: Keep common offer metadata and add clear search/filter navigation back to results.
Testable acceptance criteria: Every listed offer has matching detail/registration data; returning preserves search.

What works well (observed scope): No-match message and clearing search work; course cards include actual buttons.
Problem / uncertainty: Free filter persists when Live is selected; mobile list is very long.
Affected task and consequence: Learner cannot find the paid offering after browsing free courses.
Recommended change: Unify mode/filter state; prioritize search and result count.
Testable acceptance criteria: Free → Live → search → clear produces correct results and retains state on return.

What works well (observed scope): Language-family buttons expose two-course ladders with clear free labels.
Problem / uncertainty: Shared header still describes old live cohort and shows paid bundle promotions.
Affected task and consequence: Free learners must separate irrelevant enrollment information from their next action.
Recommended change: Give free catalogue its own concise introduction and learning-focused actions.
Testable acceptance criteria: Free page clearly says self-paced/free and offers a next course without paid-enrollment ambiguity.

What works well (observed scope): Price, access, duration and modules are visible; real module/continue buttons.
Problem / uncertainty: Dense outcome text; average/every-task/final-exam wording conflict.
Affected task and consequence: Learners cannot reliably identify when they have completed the course.
Recommended change: Show concise outcomes and one canonical completion checklist.
Testable acceptance criteria: Progress, certificate eligibility and copy agree for pass/fail boundary fixtures.

What works well (observed scope): Embedding and watched-marker code exist; lesson/title hierarchy is present.
Problem / uncertainty: Playback untested; watch status is browser/track local and not account synced.
Affected task and consequence: Device/shared-browser changes may make watched state surprising.
Recommended change: Explain local-only markers or sync them per account; provide captions/transcript and fallback links.
Testable acceptance criteria: Playback/captions and recovery are verified in a browser; watch status behaves as described across accounts/devices.

What works well (observed scope): Brief, expected output, hint, Run, submit status and retry affordances present; web code runs at both widths.
Problem / uncertainty: Task switch/refresh loses draft; grading outage has no durable retry.
Affected task and consequence: A learner can lose work and become stuck waiting for grade/certificate.
Recommended change: Autosave per task/account and introduce a persistent grading-status timeline.
Testable acceptance criteria: Draft and prior result survive navigation, reload, login and provider failure; retry resolves the same task.

What works well (observed scope): Signed-out gate and signed-in multi-file editor render; local project storage implementation exists.
Problem / uncertainty: Standalone Python/SQL/multi-file persistence not completed; external C/C++/Java execution blocked.
Affected task and consequence: Full advertised language support remains unverified.
Recommended change: Provide visible runtime setup/loading/error/cancel states and account-scoped drafts.
Testable acceptance criteria: Each supported language passes valid/invalid/stdin/timeout/retry cases; project files survive reload and do not leak across accounts.

What works well (observed scope): Labels, password masking and invalid-credential feedback work; role-based landing exists.
Problem / uncertainty: Requested destination is discarded; secondary mobile links have small hit areas.
Affected task and consequence: Users repeat navigation after sign-in.
Recommended change: Preserve a safe return URL and enlarge recovery/signup hit areas.
Testable acceptance criteria: Sign-in from every protected entry returns there; touch and keyboard reach recovery easily.

What works well (observed scope): Explains account/course-registration choices; duplicate API signup is rejected.
Problem / uncertainty: Keyboard focus is outside the dialog; verification delivery unavailable in test environment.
Affected task and consequence: Keyboard users can activate obscured page controls; onboarding completion cannot be certified.
Recommended change: Trap and restore focus; present verification status and recovery without losing form input.
Testable acceptance criteria: Tab remains in dialog; code resend/expiry/wrong-code paths retain all valid fields.

What works well (observed scope): Local reset validates length and consumes token once; invalid link screen is clear.
Problem / uncertainty: Old authenticated sessions remain valid; portal users require academy assistance.
Affected task and consequence: Recovery cannot terminate an unwanted active session.
Recommended change: Revoke old sessions and explain the recovery route by account type.
Testable acceptance criteria: Reset invalidates all pre-reset tokens; each supported account type has a usable next step.

What works well (observed scope): Resume learning works; empty account has explicit no-course messages; real grade/quiz achievements appear.
Problem / uncertainty: Large recommendation area pushes support/rewards lower on mobile; summaries cut mid-word.
Affected task and consequence: Returning learner spends effort locating the next task and new learners lack a direct enrollment checklist.
Recommended change: Prioritize next task, upcoming deadlines and a concise onboarding card; clamp summaries cleanly.
Testable acceptance criteria: An enrolled and an empty learner each see a clear primary next action above secondary recommendations.

What works well (observed scope): Nonempty profile save persists; free profile exposes password change; account menu groups settings.
Problem / uncertainty: Clearing optional fields silently fails; Settings route is lost on refresh.
Affected task and consequence: Users cannot remove outdated information and may believe it was removed.
Recommended change: Support explicit clears and stable Settings route; return saved canonical values.
Testable acceptance criteria: Blank optional values remain cleared after reload; Settings opens directly and survives refresh.

What works well (observed scope): Enrolled course opens; paid submitted code and attached lesson persist.
Problem / uncertainty: Private file download skips enrollment check; task URL/draft not durable.
Affected task and consequence: Unrelated users can retrieve a private attachment and students lose edits.
Recommended change: Authorize attachment access and persist task routes/drafts.
Testable acceptance criteria: Nonmembers denied by both course and attachment APIs; task state restores after reload.

What works well (observed scope): Quest-based assignment list and teacher remarks render when requests succeed.
Problem / uncertainty: Simulated 503 leaves Loading forever.
Affected task and consequence: Student cannot see work or decide how to recover.
Recommended change: Use explicit error with Retry and preserve previously loaded data.
Testable acceptance criteria: Timeout/503/offline cases replace loader and can recover with one retry.

What works well (observed scope): Brief, student work, prior grade, lateness and remarks are together; learner receives stored grade/feedback.
Problem / uncertainty: AI review was unavailable; small header logo appears compressed in screenshot.
Affected task and consequence: Teacher review is otherwise clear but brand treatment and integration feedback need refinement.
Recommended change: Preserve logo aspect ratio and show AI capability/status while keeping manual grade usable.
Testable acceptance criteria: Manual grade remains usable when AI fails; logo retains natural proportions in both layouts.

What works well (observed scope): API lifecycle scores correct answer, persists gems, and prevents duplicate/nonmember attempts.
Problem / uncertainty: Teacher can override batch in create payload; full browser timed-attempt flow not tested.
Affected task and consequence: Teacher can affect an unrelated course; timed recovery remains uncertain.
Recommended change: Bind quiz to authorized batch and add visible time/attempt-submit recovery.
Testable acceptance criteria: Cross-batch creation is blocked; a learner can submit/recover a timed attempt without double scoring.

What works well (observed scope): Real task and quiz gem events display; progression target is visible; gem aggregation unit check passes.
Problem / uncertainty: Landing thresholds differ; free completion/certification policies disagree.
Affected task and consequence: Learner cannot predict milestones or understand a partially complete certified course.
Recommended change: Use one server-owned progression/completion model for all surfaces.
Testable acceptance criteria: Same fixture yields identical totals, stage and completion in every view.

What works well (observed scope): Synthetic serial verifies publicly; invalid serial fails clearly; share PNG renders.
Problem / uncertainty: Teacher can issue course certificate to a nonmember; share/QR scanning not completed.
Affected task and consequence: Verification can authenticate a record with an invalid completion basis.
Recommended change: Validate eligibility before issuance, then show clear verification and revocation states.
Testable acceptance criteria: Only eligible/authorized records are issued; public state matches persisted serial and revocation status.

What works well (observed scope): Event registration/submission/cutoff and simulated payment gates pass locally; legacy team scoring/finalization works for stored entries.
Problem / uncertainty: Repeated teammates receive duplicate prizes; rejected event proof cannot be replaced through registration. Live meetings and large-result pagination remain untested.
Affected task and consequence: Rewards can be incorrect, and payment-proof recovery needs academy contact.
Recommended change: Deduplicate team members; show payment review status, a replacement-proof action and the next step.
Testable acceptance criteria: Each person receives one prize; a rejected proof can be corrected with history preserved; expired/paid/unregistered variants receive clear outcomes.

What works well (observed scope): Link validation and reject→revise→approve persist; repeated identical approval awards gems once.
Problem / uncertainty: An administrative API correction after approval can double the reward. UI review actions only appear for pending work.
Affected task and consequence: Learner gem totals can disagree with the final challenge result.
Recommended change: Define supported review transitions and an auditable reward correction process.
Testable acceptance criteria: One win produces one reward; authorized corrections update the status and reward consistently and explain the change to the learner.

What works well (observed scope): Announcement page has a clear empty state; feedback is hidden until approval and excludes email publicly.
Problem / uncertainty: Delivery fan-out and full submit/reply UI not completed.
Affected task and consequence: Audience receipt and moderation completion remain uncertain.
Recommended change: Separate publication status from message delivery and expose moderation confirmation.
Testable acceptance criteria: Correct audiences see published content; no email is exposed; failed delivery has recovery.

What works well (observed scope): Course-member data and conversation UI exist; stored message is retrievable.
Problem / uncertainty: Read-only coordinator documentation conflicts with writable chat; anonymous/mention lifecycle not completed.
Affected task and consequence: Participants may misunderstand authority or anonymity.
Recommended change: State who can read/post/moderate and explain anonymous mode precisely.
Testable acceptance criteria: Role and privacy tests cover post/reply/delete/mentions without leaking hidden identity.

What works well (observed scope): Actual job card→detail navigation works at 1440px and 390px; saved learner comment and external application explanation are visible.
Problem / uncertainty: Job details use an in-page view without a stable URL; employer submission and combined filters remain unverified.
Affected task and consequence: A learner cannot reliably bookmark or resume the job through refresh, and the external outcome is outside this audit.
Recommended change: Give each job a stable route and preserve search context; retain the explicit external-application explanation.
Testable acceptance criteria: Job detail survives refresh/Back; comments persist; open/closed postings expose the correct action; application links resolve in designated staging.

What works well (observed scope): Project gallery replaces loader with a clear unavailable response in local mode.
Problem / uncertainty: PostgreSQL unavailable; successful publication/search not verified.
Affected task and consequence: Visitors cannot reach meaningful talent content in this configuration.
Recommended change: Render a usable feature-unavailable state and keep database setup details private.
Testable acceptance criteria: Configured staging passes publish→public-view with contact/resume privacy checks; unavailable state has recovery.

What works well (observed scope): Navigation separates profile and hiring requests.
Problem / uncertainty: Both views remain Loading on real local 503.
Affected task and consequence: Students have no route forward or explanation.
Recommended change: Shared error/retry handling plus capability-aware entry.
Testable acceptance criteria: 503 replaces spinner and retry works; consent workflow passes with a scratch database.

What works well (observed scope): Structured company fields; pending and approved screens; API review/resubmit/approve transitions pass.
Problem / uncertainty: Signup/company matching and inbox delivery not fully tested; approved actions lead to unavailable database-dependent features locally.
Affected task and consequence: New recruiter can be verified while useful hiring actions are unavailable.
Recommended change: Separate account approval from service availability; keep request-info context visible while editing.
Testable acceptance criteria: Needs-info data survives correction; approved users reach functioning search or a recoverable unavailable state.

What works well (observed scope): Routes and form structures were inventoried, including consent and per-recruiter gates.
Problem / uncertainty: No PostgreSQL test data; functionality and privacy outcomes not executed.
Affected task and consequence: Hiring and contact safety remain unverified.
Recommended change: Prioritize scratch-database tests for filtering, pagination, consent and resume access.
Testable acceptance criteria: Correctly scoped recruiter requests, consent, messaging and list persistence pass; unrelated recruiters denied.

What works well (observed scope): Signed-in empty feed renders; no-image validation works; signed-out user is gated.
Problem / uncertainty: Every post requires R2 image storage, unavailable locally; destination lost after login.
Affected task and consequence: Student cannot publish or return directly to intended feed.
Recommended change: Preserve destination and expose image capability/retry before accepting work.
Testable acceptance criteria: Sandbox post→like/comment/report→moderate completes with correct cohort visibility and retryable image upload.

What works well (observed scope): Actual counts, upcoming admin actions and explicit SMTP-unconfigured detail are present.
Problem / uncertainty: Health card wraps poorly, escaped separator text appears, test/disabled delivery can look operational.
Affected task and consequence: Operators may misread service readiness.
Recommended change: Use clear state labels and responsive diagnostic rows.
Testable acceptance criteria: No clipped status at target widths; unavailable/dry-run is visually distinct from operational.

What works well (observed scope): Role-specific lists render; designated accounts and batch creation work locally.
Problem / uncertainty: Bulk destructive changes and cascade recovery not tested.
Affected task and consequence: Administrative mistakes may have unverified consequences.
Recommended change: Add affected-record preview, meaningful confirmation and recovery for destructive operations.
Testable acceptance criteria: Synthetic create→assign→remove cases preserve intended history and reject unauthorized roles.

What works well (observed scope): Read access to core users/enrollments is available.
Problem / uncertainty: Visible subsections call endpoints that return 403 and leave partial loaders.
Affected task and consequence: Coordinator meets dead ends in duties exposed by navigation.
Recommended change: Define one capability map and remove unsupported actions.
Testable acceptance criteria: All visible coordinator tabs complete or explain their state without 403 dead ends.

What works well (observed scope): Stage folders, counts, explicit handoff instructions and per-record actions are clear.
Problem / uncertainty: Duplicate/invalid registrations, false mailed stage and broken bundle fulfillment.
Affected task and consequence: Applicant may be stuck or charged the wrong amount while staff see a misleading status.
Recommended change: Model offerings/bundles, deduplicate requests and make delivery a first-class state.
Testable acceptance criteria: Normal, duplicate, invalid, bundled and failed-email cases complete correctly or provide a recoverable stage.

What works well (observed scope): Payment-cleared stage and public paid document match local persisted state; PDF generates.
Problem / uncertainty: Real payment proof, reconciliation and expense workflows untested; default bank data is placeholder.
Affected task and consequence: Payment collection and reconciliation cannot be certified from local tests.
Recommended change: Validate bank configuration before issuing payable documents and distinguish manual verification from automatic settlement.
Testable acceptance criteria: Sandbox proof→verification→admissions handoff works; invalid/default bank setup prevents a misleading payable invoice.

What works well (observed scope): Role-specific portal; synthetic instructor/ambassador PDFs parse as 12/13 pages with party details.
Problem / uncertainty: Signed-return, deadline/email and document access completion untested; shared upload authorization weak.
Affected task and consequence: Private identity/contract data can be exposed and onboarding recovery remains uncertain.
Recommended change: Secure per-person documents and expose resumable stages and delivery/signature status.
Testable acceptance criteria: Only authorized people can access documents; every required upload/signature/deadline case has recovery.

What works well (observed scope): HR instructions/reply and targeted department-task completion persist; duplicate department and nonmember-head checks work.
Problem / uncertainty: Task proof-file, return-for-correction and complete browser form sequence remain unverified.
Affected task and consequence: Normal local completion works, but evidence correction and reopening need dedicated validation.
Recommended change: Make status, owner, due date and evidence submission explicit.
Testable acceptance criteria: A task can be assigned, completed, returned for correction and reopened without losing evidence.

What works well (observed scope): Portal renders referral identity; synthetic referral plus stacked discount reaches enrollment and one correct gem award.
Problem / uncertainty: Cash commission payout, report email and signing were not completed.
Affected task and consequence: Earned gems have local evidence; downstream cash payout remains unverified.
Recommended change: Show how referral registration differs from paid enrollment and when gems/commission accrue.
Testable acceptance criteria: A referral keeps its discount snapshot, generates one correct reward/report entry, and exposes the commission payment status.

What works well (observed scope): Plain-language privacy content renders; talent contact-gating design is documented in code.
Problem / uncertainty: Formal privacy/legal review, public profile photo access and request fulfillment not tested.
Affected task and consequence: Published promises may exceed tested safeguards.
Recommended change: Align wording with actual role access and feature availability; make contact/help routes clear.
Testable acceptance criteria: Functional privacy promises are backed by access tests; no compliance claim is made solely from this audit.

What works well (observed scope): Form labels, dialog semantics, Escape handling and global visible-focus/reduced-motion styles exist.
Problem / uncertainty: Modal focus not captured/trapped; several secondary mobile links have 15–16px boxes.
Affected task and consequence: Keyboard users reach obscured controls and touch targets are hard to select.
Recommended change: Use a reusable accessible dialog and consistent padded secondary actions.
Testable acceptance criteria: Keyboard completes open/use/close with focus restored; touch interactions avoid adjacent activation.
